web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's private Composite PMI rose to 52.1 in August, indicating expansion, while the services PMI increased to 51.4. The official Composite PMI increased to 49.5, and the manufacturing PMI rose to 49.8, both showing slight improvement but remaining below the 50 mark indicating contraction. The private-sector services PMI climbed to 51.5, beating forecasts and marking a two-month high.
